targets.title: L3 syntactic transfer selectivity and typological determinacy: The typological primacy model.
targets.evidence_quote: The present study was an approximate replication of Rothman (2011).
targets.outcome_quote:
Overall, the
results of the two ANOVAs point to a partial replication of the original analysis. A full
replication for the purpose of the present study would have included no main effect of
group (which was replicated for both tasks) and no group x position interaction
(which was only replicated for one task).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The author explicitly calls the replication partial, explaining that both group null effects replicated but the interaction replicated only in one task. This is an overall partial verdict. Numerical inconsistencies elsewhere in the article do not change that stated verdict.
